Fail-fast: load until maxS 600, timeoutMin 25, crash = FAIL with the EA xcpt / [Crash] fault for triage (docs/320 §1.2 sites: physics quadtree 0..4096 reject, scene quadtree 2048 default, WTXT null lookups). Household: no Sim behaviour change, no code under test. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/large-worlds-load-1122.json --no-smoke
